ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) linear and circular clusters. Macro-ratio estimated at approximately 6:1 (dark to light) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity regions cover the central and peduncle-adjacent areas. High-intensity white linear markings are distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes, with high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending roughly 15 percent into the visible vertical fluke depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (sawtooth pattern) with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels relative to the mean edge line, occurring continuously across the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; convex expansion from the median notch transitioning into a concave taper toward the sharp, slightly upturned lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity white circular pixel clusters (~10-20 pixels in diameter) localized along the trailing edges and scattered across the left lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear tracks (rake marks) varying from 50 to 200 pixels in length across the mid-ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring across the majority of the ventral surface; irregular, jagged topography observed on the distal edge of the left lobe suggesting minor past trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity specular reflection (glare) on the inner-left lobe obscuring underlying pixel-level pigmentation in that specific coordinate zone.
